title: Operations Director
text:
Reference

EPR009714

Posting Reference

Location

Remote, Remote, USA

Type

Full Time

Job Category

Operations

EthosEnergy O&M is recruiting for an Operations Director responsible for providing contract oversight and leadership to the Facility Managers in support of our Operations & Maintenance Contracts, as well as supporting the Business Development efforts for the Region. This individual is responsible for delivering a superior customer experience for both internal and external customers. Qualified candidates must have a minimum of (10)-ten years of power plant O&M experience with a minimum of (8)-eight years in a plant or corporate management position. Note extensive travel is required to meet with Plant Managers and Owner Representatives. This position reports to a VP of Operations and will be based remotely in the United States of America.

#### **Job Responsibilities**

* Ensure that assigned facilities are operated and maintained in a Safe and environmentally responsible manner.
* Provide supervision and leadership to Facility Managers and assigned staff. Provide coaching, training, and development opportunities to ensure appropriate skill sets are maintained. This includes the implementation and scheduling of training programs that cover operations, maintenance, safety, regulatory, and personal development areas.
* Fully understand contracts, O&M Agreements (OMA) and where applicable Long Term Service Agreements and Collective Bargaining Agreements for each Facility and ensure that the terms and activities of each agreement are followed and satisfied. Ensure all reports and information required under the terms of the OMA are prepared and submitted in a timely manner.
* Support EthosEnergy O&M policy development and ensure compliance with all company policies, procedures, and commercial commitments.
* Implement programs and activities that provide for a work environment that promotes effective goal accomplishment, productivity, and morale.
* Establish and maintain regular communications with Facility Owners to discuss plant performance and problem resolution. Schedule periodic meetings with Owners as per the OMA.
* Collect and / or review O&M Financial, HSE and Quality performance looking for trends that would require proactive implementation of countermeasures.
* Participate in EthosEnergy O&M Business Development meetings and activities. Help prepare O&M proposals for new and renewal projects and help identify potential business opportunities.
* Implement process improvements within EthosEnergy O&M, contribute to companywide improvements and help identify and track key performance indicators at both the plant and corporate levels.
* Special projects as assigned.
 

 

#### **Required Skills / Knowledge**

* A thorough demonstrated understanding of power plant operations, including a working knowledge of the operations & maintenance functions.
* A thorough, demonstrated knowledge of energy facility operations, O&M contracts and management methods are necessary to control and improve the business.
* A working knowledge of chemistry as it relates to plant operations as well as environmental and water treatment programs and statutory regulations
* Understand budgets, bid proposals contract evaluation and basic accounting principals, plant economics and power pool operations.
* Analyzes and interprets data to make sound professional judgments and recommendations.
* Ability to manage and motivate subordinates.
* Extensive travel is required to meet with Plant Managers and Owner Representatives Experience
* A minimum of (10)-ten years of power plant O&M with a minimum of (8)-eight years in a plant or corporate management position.
 

 

#### **Experience**

* A minimum of ten years of Power Plant O&M experience with significant prior Facility / Plant Manager experience, with diverse Energy Industry and corporate management experience a plus. International power generation experience in a leadership capacity is required for this role.
* Must have experience in managing thermal gas fired generation assets (combined cycles, rankin cycles, reciprocating engines, etc.). Renewable experience a plus.
* Greenfield start-up, commissioning, and operations phase experience a plus.
 

 

#### **Education Requirements**

* A four-year degree or commensurate experience is required as well as a demonstrated track record of successful goal accomplishment. Advanced degree or certification a plus.
 

 

#### **Physical Requirements**

* Some physical exertion in the form of walking, reaching, climbing, stooping, and lifting (up to 50 pounds) is required. This position requires travel which may include to international locations.
 

 

#### **What We Offer**

* Supportive company culture that values its employees
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision & 401 K Plan
* Paid Parental Leave, Time Off & Holidays
* Extra money in your paycheck - Employee Referral Bonus
* Personal Development & Career Succession Planning
* Company sponsored Perks & Discount programs

EthosEnergy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.
